final: WITH j AS (SELECT e.type AS type, b.remaining AS remaining, (b.amount - b.spent) AS diff FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(remaining) AS avg_rem, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM j GROUP BY type), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall FROM t), k AS (SELECT t.avg_rem, t.avg_diff, t.avg_diff - o.overall AS delta FROM t JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE t.avg_diff > o.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(delta) AS avg_delta FROM k
